title.narrative: DEVELOPMENT OF THE 2020 - 2024 STRATEGIC PLAN OF THE FONAHD DRC PLATFORM

description.narrative: The project aims to organize 2 workshops (1 for 4 days and one for 3 days) to develop a contextualized Strategic Plan 2020-2024 and a 2020 Operational Action Plan (OAP-2020). This project will allow members of the FONAHD DRC to meet to re-examine the relevance of the vision, the mission and the values, to make an inventory of the FONAHD DRC platform: its composition, its structures, its reading policy of the current humanitarian context, analyse the internal and external context of FONAHD DRC, define the future direction of FONAHD DRC: strategic objectives, working approach, geographical coverage, type and quality of members, partnership and resource mobilization, strengths, threats and risks , highlight the 2020 Operational Action Plan.FONAHD DRC is a platform created in 2010 by Congolese law organizations whose the aim is to see more resilient Congolese communities where vulnerable populations are able to prepare for the risks of disasters, hazards and climate change. Mitigate their effects, recover from them and adapt to them. Today, the platform counts 35 strong and capable member organizations to intervene as quickly as possible, according to their possibilities, in the different territories of the North Kivu Province. The programming activities of the FONAHD DRC platform are implemented at the local, provincial and national levels and reflect eight thematic areas according to the Clusters Approach, namely: Protection, Education, Food Security, Gender and Gender-Based Violence. , WASH, Logistics, Health, Nutrition and HIV / AIDS, Shelter, Food and Non-Food.
